title: Register with Vermont Saves or certify a retirement plan exemption
description: Employers with five or more employees and no qualified plan must register or certify an exemption; phase-in ended around July 1, 2026. Penalty up to $20 per covered employee through September 30, 2026 and $75 per covered employee per calendar year from October 1, 2026; paying does not end the obligation.

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)
